verdict.rationale: Mistral's agent tooling lets you get AI analysis of your own data. Code Interpreter runs on-demand data analysis and graphing in isolated containers. Document Library adds built-in RAG over uploaded documents, and agents can connect to your data sources via function calling or MCP. However, this mostly means building agents through the API rather than using a ready-made in-product insights or suggestions feature, and the evidence is one-line doc summaries. Missing for 10: an explicit in-product feature that proactively surfaces insights or suggestions from user data, in-depth docs on the data-analysis workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
